documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported financial results for FY19 and Q1FY20, noting a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19 and a double-digit revenue growth start in Q1FY20. Management highlighted margin expansion driven by volume growth, benign raw material prices, and a larger contribution from international operations. The company outlined ongoing capital expenditure plans, distribution expansions, and continued focus on debt rationalization and operational efficiency across its domestic and international markets. Vadilal Industries reported robust financial and operational performance for Q3 and 9M FY19, driven by significant growth in both domestic and international revenues. Management highlighted expanding gross margins due to favorable product mix, export realizations, and lower raw material costs, alongside disciplined cost management and debt rationalization.

guidance.claim: Management expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver double digit growth with higher international contribution leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the estimated capex for FY 19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
guidance.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption in many core markets was impacted in Q4 by exceptionally severe weather conditions extending the winter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% during FY19, driven by strong demand for ice creams and other products within the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19. International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% during Q2, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% international business expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that international revenues contributed 32% to turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects to see continued traction from consumers looking for distinctly Indian products backed by a strong brand.
demand_outlook.quote: We have already invested in marketing and distribution reach and expect to see continued traction from consumers looking for distinctly Indian products backed by a strong brand.

demand_outlook.claim: Going forward, management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued traction in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

capex_expansion.claim: Distribution investments have already been committed in multiple locations in the U.S. to provide widespread access to key target markets.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote:  No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the estimated capex for FY19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: The company reported no major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that they are making investments in IT enhancement and balancing equipment at the factory to drive greater volumes.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also making investments in IT enhancement and balancing equipment at the factory to drive greater volumes.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger contribution from international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations having a base of over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Other operating expenses were kept under tight control and remained almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Stable costs are covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Prices will be looked to be increased in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margin expansion was achieved through volume growth, utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices, and operating cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that international ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, helping improve profits and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote:  Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that current production is on automated processes untouched by hand, with manual intervention only at the packaging stage.
orders_capacity.quote:  Current production on automated processes “untouched by hand”, manual intervention only at packaging stage

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: o Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that cash accretion and improvements in working capital allow continued debt rationalization, leading to decreasing interest expenses.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted in the disclaimer that forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties like regulatory changes and local political or economic developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward- looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, like regulatory changes, local political or economic developments, and many other factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those contemplated by the relevant forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an intention to expand the distribution network judiciously.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
